title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Borrower Evidence and Cancellation Credit Terms
content:
The borrower-evidence and cancellation-credit terms of the **Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs** are the same for all six tiers (Residential Mandatory Amount, Residential Gap, Residential Replacement Cost, Manufactured Home, Commercial Building, Commercial Building and Contents).

| Term | Meaning | Value on every tier |
|---|---|---|
| Mortgagee clause | Whether borrower evidence must name the lender as mortgagee to be acceptable | Yes |
| Private policies | Which private policies are acceptable borrower evidence | A private policy carrying the private flood compliance aid statement, or one the lender accepts in writing |
| Flat cancellation | Whether a certificate is cancelled from its start when the borrower's coverage was in force on that date | Yes |
| Overlap refund period | Days after confirmation of the borrower's coverage is received within which the certificate is cancelled and the overlap premium credited | 30 calendar days |
| Loan payoff | Credit method when the loan is paid off | Pro rata |
| Servicing transfer | Credit method when servicing of the loan moves to another servicer | Pro rata |
| Removal from the Special Flood Hazard Area | Credit method when a Letter of Map Amendment or Revision removes the building from the Special Flood Hazard Area | Pro rata |
| Paid claim | Whether a certificate with a paid claim earns its full premium | Yes |

## Scoped exceptions stated by the program's schedules
- **Flat cancellation.** For the overlap credit on the certificate named on the acceptable borrower evidence most recently received on the program, and only for that credit, the credit and its effective date are figured by the overlap schedule.
- **Loan payoff, servicing transfer and removal from the area.** For a loan event that the lender reports on the day it takes effect, on the certificate most recently issued under the program, and only for such an event, the loan-event credit is figured by the loan-event schedule.

## Reading the terms
- The overlap refund period of 30 calendar days runs from the date the evidence of the borrower's coverage is received.
